steps: Play the five chapters in order. The 12 story trophies pop as you go and none of them can be missed.

Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — the morning after Down to Earth, follow her from the kitchen to the balcony. It is the one possibly missable step in the whole list (Positive Mental Attitude).
Take optional missions and character quests as they appear: many are only offered for a while.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go — 200 vehicle scans and 100 animal studies count toward 100%.
Meditate with both characters whenever a spot appears, and turn on every progress and collectible notification in Settings.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. There are 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave, and no mission replay.
Keep cheats off — using one disables trophies and saving.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5

steps: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Everything you did before already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
Work the checklist in the table below: five groups in full, the rest only in part. PowerPyx calls it roughly 60% of true completion.
Most of the miscellaneous trophies pop along the way — stunts, races, robberies, scans and spending all feed the checklist.
stages.title: The 100% checklist

steps: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. They are not part of 100%, so they may still be open.
Close out the character quest lines: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.
Sweep the remaining one-offs — the jet at VCIA, the tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the bowling alley — and the platinum follows.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and clean-up

time: About 200 hours (PowerPyx); Push Square says 250+ hours
title: Road to the Platinum
warnings: No mission replay and no New Game+. One playthrough is enough, but a missed Chapter 1 meditation can't be replayed — keep manual saves.
Cheats disable trophies and saving (GTABase). The 61 cheats only unlock after the story anyway (PowerPyx).
Don't push toward the Irredeemable Criminal Profile — it's permanent (GTABase).
Five trophies have no confirmed method yet: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin. This guide says so instead of guessing (GTABase, OutputLag).
